description: This file contains unit tests for the RemotePortTunnel component, testing scenarios such as stderr handling and port availability detection on Darwin-based systems.

classes.name: RemotePortTunnelTests
classes.description: A structure containing test methods for RemotePortTunnel functionality on Darwin systems.

methods.name: `drain stderr does not crash when handle closed`
methods.description: Tests that draining stderr with a closed handle does not crash and results in an empty output.

methods.name: `port is free detects I pv4 listener`
methods.description: Tests whether the system correctly detects that a specific IP and ephemeral port is in use and becomes free after closing the socket.
